image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of a curved wooden bannister (handrail and balusters) in an indoor setting, likely a restaurant or hotel. The handrail is dark polished wood with a smooth, rounded profile, curving diagonally from the bottom left to the upper right. It is supported by numerous slender, vertical wooden balusters that are evenly spaced. Strong specular highlights from overhead recessed lighting reflect off the polished surfaces of the handrail and balusters, creating bright white streaks. The background shows a warm-toned interior with a wooden floor, walls, and ceiling lights, slightly out of focus.
